result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, **I'd recommend HubSpot CRM as the best overall starting point.** It's relatively easy to use, has a free version, and gives you room to grow without immediately investing in an expensive system.

However, the best CRM depends on how your team manages customers, leads, sales, and follow-ups.

Here are my top five choices for 2026.

## Best CRMs for a small team

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Free plan available for up to 2 users.
- Contact and customer management.
- Sales pipeline tracking.
- Email tracking and marketing integrations.

Best if you want an easy-to-use system that can grow with your business.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Excellent visual sales pipeline.
- Tracks leads and opportunities.
- Makes follow-ups easier.
- Straightforward interface.

Best if your team actively sells products or services and needs to track deals.

[Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best value)

- Free plan for up to 3 users.
- Strong automation features.
- Customizable dashboards.
- Integrates with other Zoho products.

Best if you want lots of functionality without spending much.

[Zoho CRM website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Free option available.
- Email, phone and chat capabilities.
- Lead scoring and automation.
- Good sales productivity tools.

Best if your team communicates with customers frequently.

[Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![Press | Less Annoying CRM](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2qatplq6csyuUFkgeu64DSNLeY1k3cfYZWtzzFx81-c9TcZwWoUySRvz6Fs_wbvTDD91lMvffHRk9HGZjKJwM802Tzpg6G1lsG_WO2SDnAIYdxUaCBlEmMtjHt5udyeu9XPFQM7DZtURs4rTvF4j6_iAo16T_2yOMKSVsb9SbIreD6LNJw75WslzAFEEf8mP?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Less Annoying CRM**

- Very easy to learn.
- Simple contact management.
- Calendar and follow-up tracking.
- Straightforward pricing.

Best if you want something simple without unnecessary complexity.

[Less Annoying CRM website](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/)

| HubSpot | Free | All-around CRM |
| Pipedrive | \~\$14/user/mo | Sales pipeline |
| Zoho CRM | Free / \~\$14 | Customization |
| Freshsales | \~\$9/user/mo | Sales communications |
| Less Annoying CRM | \~\$15/user/mo | Simplicity |


\*Approximate USD pricing, generally based on annual billing. Confirm regional pricing and feature limits before purchasing.
